candidates.change_summary: Remove the assert statement in deposit() so overflow is not checked.
Replace addition with direct assignment to balances so that only the latest msg.value is stored, not accumulated.
Delete the balance update so deposit() does not change the sender's balance.
Delete the require statement that checks the balance, allowing withdrawal of any amount.
Delete the balance deduction after transfer, allowing double-spending of the same balance.
Replace the balance deduction with a constant assignment to zero, making withdrawals drain the full balance regardless of the requested amount.
Move the balance deduction before the transfer, creating a reentrancy-like effect where the balance is reduced before funds are actually sent.
Replace `payable(to).transfer(address(this).balance);` with `payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance);` so the balance goes to the caller instead of the parameter.
Replace `require(creator == msg.sender);` with `require(true);` to remove the access control, allowing anyone to call migrateTo.
Delete `require(creator == msg.sender);` so anyone can call migrateTo.
Replace `require(creator == msg.sender);` with `require(creator != msg.sender);` so only non-creator can call migrateTo.
Replace `payable(to).transfer(address(this).balance);` with `payable(to).transfer(1);` so only 1 wei is transferred.
Insert `creator = msg.sender;` after the transfer so the creator changes after migration.
